description: This Java class 'StandingInstructionAssembler' handles the assembly of standing instructions for account transfers within the Fineract project, including methods to assemble transfer details and standing instructions from JSON commands.

classes.name: StandingInstructionAssembler
classes.description: Service class responsible for assembling account transfer details and standing instructions from JSON commands.

methods.name: assembleSavingsToSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Creates transfer details for savings-to-savings transfers and attaches standing instructions.

methods.name: assembleStandingInstruction
methods.description: Populates standing instruction details from JSON command into account transfer details.

methods.name: assembleSavingsToLoanTransfer
methods.description: Creates transfer details for savings-to-loan transfers and attaches standing instructions.

methods.name: assembleLoanToSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Creates transfer details for loan-to-savings transfers and attaches standing instructions.
